announcements.headline: Result of Secondary Placing
announcements.insight: This announcement confirms the completion of a secondary placing, which typically involves raising new capital or selling existing shares. For shareholders, this indicates a potential dilution of equity stakes and provides insight into investor sentiment regarding the company's future prospects.

announcements.headline: Interim results for six months ended 30 June 2026
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies the release of scheduled interim financial results for the first half of the year. It provides shareholders with an update on the company's performance and financial position during this period.

announcements.headline: Trading Update & Interim Results Publication Date
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies the release of scheduled interim financial results and a trading update, which are routine disclosures providing shareholders with an overview of the company's recent performance.
